messages:
Marc: Quick heads-up — saw repeated queue rejects for model `redwood-7b` in eu-west1 around 11:40 UTC. For several P2 tenants we hit saturation and requests errored with 503.
Rita: Do we have a telemetry signal we can use to trigger fallback? queue_length? reject_rate? latency?
Oliver: We already emit `model_capacity_utilization` and `gpu_queue_depth`. I'd use utilization >= 0.9 for 15s. Rejects are noisy.
Sanjay: Product note: Premium tenants should not be auto-downgraded without consent. Proposal: per-tenant policy `allow_auto_variant_fallback: bool` + default by tier.
Lina: Also need console UX: a toggle in Routes/Models: "Enable capacity-based fallback" with per-tenant override, and a dashboard card showing `fallback_rate` and example requests.
Marc: Prototype rule (config idea):
```json
{
  "policy": "tiered_capacity_fallback",
  "scope": "tenant+region",
  "conditions": [{"metric":"model_capacity_utilization","op":">=","value":0.9,"duration":"15s"}],
  "fallback_order": ["redwood-7b-q4a","redwood-7b-q4_kv"],
  "preserve_tier": true
}
```
Rita: Need to define SLAs: allowed quality drop per tier. Maybe `max_quality_drop": "minor|moderate|none"`.
Oliver: Telemetry: emit event `fallback.triggered` with tags `tenant_id, region, original_model, fallback_model, trigger_metric, trigger_value`. Also counters `fallback.count` and histograms for `fallback.latency_delta_ms`.
Sanjay: Pricing/legal: if fallback causes incorrect outputs, who owns risk? Add audit log + opt-in for enterprise.
Lina: Implementation note: runtime should mark the response with `x-fallback: model=redwood-7b-q4a;reason=capacity` so customers can filter in logs.
Marc: Cross-region routing? If eu region saturated but us-east has spare capacity, should we prefer cross-region first? That has egress/data residency implications.
Rita: Suggest order: 1) same region variant, 2) same region lower-quality, 3) cross-region same model if tenant allows cross-region. Config knobs.
Oliver: I'll add metrics + alerting for `fallback.rate > 0.01` per tenant. Keep canary for 2 weeks.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: PR #4027 for routing-policy-service ready for review :rocket:
Marc: Action items: Rita to spec policy schema, Lina to design console toggle, Oliver to add telemetry, Sanjay to draft enterprise opt-in language. I'll open RFC.
Rita: 👍 I'll start a draft today.
Sanjay: adding a note: during canary, surface an automatic email to affected tenants when we enable fallback.
Lina: putting mockups in figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/fallback-ui
Marc: Thanks—keeping this thread as the coordination point.
